products.name: Wash Equipment Downtime Handoff
products.product: A focused car wash equipment downtime tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent express, tunnel, and multi-bay car wash operators
products.problem: A conveyor, pump, arch, pay station, dryer, reclaim system, or bay can remain degraded across shifts while containment, vendor response, parts, customer impact, and return-to-service testing live in separate messages.
products.valueProposition: Turns car wash equipment downtime tracking into a visible operating queue so every equipment incident has contained customer impact, named repair ownership, shift-to-shift status, and verified return to service.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets car wash maintenance software, car wash equipment downtime, car wash work order, and wash equipment repair log searches.

products.name: Membership Billing Exception
products.product: A focused car wash membership billing exception tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent express, tunnel, and multi-bay car wash operators
products.problem: Failed renewals, duplicate plans, plate changes, cancellation requests, refunds, disputed charges, and access status can diverge between POS, processor, and customer support.
products.valueProposition: Turns car wash membership billing exception tracking into a visible operating queue so every membership exception resolves billing, access, customer communication, and future renewal state with one documented decision.
products.topic: car wash membership billing exception tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets car wash membership software, car wash billing dispute, unlimited wash plan cancellation, and car wash failed payment searches.
